conventions:
READ ME
=======
FARE AND TOURISM RATE REFERENCE - PANGASINAN / ALAMINOS
Currency: Philippine peso (PHP). Values are transcribed from the attached source PDFs. Each source is identified; historical guides remain historical. A blank cell in a source is 
not a zero charge. Rates may change; verify with the operator or issuing office before quoting a current price.
DATA CONVENTIONS
- Vehicle tables retain the source's distance (km), regular fare, and discounted fare columns. In September 2026 bus tables, OLD and NEW columns are kept distinct.
- Student / senior citizen / PWD columns indicate the source's 20% discount category. Fare guides generally round to the nearest PHP 0.25; use the listed table value for the listed 
distance.
- This document does not infer point-to-point fares from straight-line distance or combine unrelated fees.
- The Alaminos tricycle ordinance PDF contains pages 2 and 3 of 4 only. Both the superseded and amended tables shown on those pages are reproduced below.
